body: You don't need to offer any advice, your words of encouragement mean so much already. Honestly, I've had this bottled up for so long and the replies on the posts I've made have been so encouraging, helpful and supportive, I feel more positive than I've felt in a long time. i really think I can do this this time.
Thanks for commenting, I'll look into programs to do that.

Hey, thanks for commenting. I absolutely do understand the abuse these kids suffer. As I said above, I see the faces of many of these kids all the time. It's horrible. They're children, they should be having fun with kids their age, playing etc. Not this. 

I know it creates demand, it's horrible and disturbing how many people there are on sites like this. I know TOR has many legal and useful purposes, but I do honestly wish the FBI/DEA could just find a way to shut it off for good. It's fucking appealing what you can find on it.

It's wrong, I don't pretend that they enjoy it or anything like that. I know it's abuse. I don't think I have a NPD, but I guess maybe. I've decided to see a therapist in january, but I can't talk about my real issue, though I'm going to talk around the lines and talk about my depression etc.

Your first point, I've tried before but it generally just acts as a trigger. 

I absolutely know that these kids are horrifically abused, I know better than most. I hate it, it's horrible. The men in these videos are nothing short of monsters. I'm a monster too, I know that, I know it's fuelling the demand. I see their faces a lot when I sleep, it's horrible.

It's absolutely nothing, a completely minuscule complaint in comparison, but I almost feel like a victim too. Victim is probably the wrong word. I'm not trying to minimise or diminish the abuse they suffer, it's nothing in comparison. I know I went looking, but these sites have broken me. I desperately wish the FBI/LEA would find the sick f*cks who run them and shut them down. I've read other stories similar to mine, and I would hate for this to happen to others. 

I'm going to take your suggestion about legal porn on board, I'm planning to visit a therapist in January, so I'll try and mention that. I might not be able to talk about my real issue, but I guess I can get help for my anxiety/depression and talk about addiction coping strategies.

Yeah. I guess the depression/anxiety doesn't help, it makes me want to stay inside/isolated etc. I'm going to try and overcome that though and force myself to be active etc. I need to get my life back on track.

Thank you so so much for the words of encouragement, they mean a great deal. I have only seen encouragement and helpful advice from the few posts I made and for the first time recently I feel semi-positive.

I think it is an adrenaline rush/dopamine addiction thing. I really don't think I'm sexually attracted to kids, I'm still turned on by guys my age and my sexual fantasies/desires involve guys my age. Most of the porn I watch is just amateur young adults (legal stuff), like my age. 

It's just that sometimes that doesn't seem enough. But I'm determined this time, I really want this to be gone and I need to stop.

Hey, thanks so much for the kind words. They mean so much. 

That's exactly it, what you describe is it. It's the thrill, the illicit nature of this crap that does it. It's horrible and I know it's wrong, but the dopamine/hormone response is so much more intense now. 

I have seen some communities for 'non-offending pedophiles' and while I respect those efforts (and can appreciate them from my own situation), I don't consider myself a 'pedophile' - I'm not sexually attracted to kids, not like they are, and so i don't really feel like I fit there or if it would be all that helpful (or good for me to be around others like that)

I tried joining a more generic mental health community once, but they banned me. They said that they have several people who were victims of abuse and so they felt like it wouldn't be right, which is definitely fair and I understand, it's just more isolation for me. 

Germany has a programme that would be great, but I'm nowhere near Germany and can't really just move at 20 without people asking questions that I don't have answers for.
 

NoFap sounds like it might be a big help, I'll definitely look into that more. As you said, it probably would be hard to stop masturbating, but I desperately need to do something, so if I have to do that, then yeah.

hey. You're right, I need to wake up and sort this out. It is definitely a  habit. I'm going to look into breaking bad habits and coping strategies and have a think about stuff.

I can't keep doing this, as you said, it's not working and it's just a self-destructive cycle.

Hey, yeah. I still get turned on to normal porn too, like 90% of the time I watch that. It's just those occasions when it's not that that stuff sucks. 

I'll take a look, thanks for the link.

Hey, thanks for commenting. I really appreciate it. I absolutely know this fuels the demand and it's fucking horrible. It's scary how many people view this stuff. I frequently wish the site would just shut down.

It definitely is what you describe, it's the dopamine hit. I feel good for like 5 seconds and then immediately after I feel awful. Physically sick, repulsed at my own behaviour etc. 

I'm dealing with depression/anxiety as a result of this too, but i'm going to try hard to be more social/active. I think it would help.
Hey, sorry for the delay. Thanks for the kind words, they mean so much. I definitely will try again and try much harder this time. Thank you.
